hooks.name: Never gitignore .kiro (submission rule)
hooks.description: Kiroween submissions are disqualified if /.kiro is ignored. Fails loudly if any .gitignore pattern matches it.

action.command: git check-ignore -q --no-index .kiro/steering/product.md && echo Kiroween rule: .kiro/ must NOT be gitignored. Remove the matching .gitignore line. && exit 1 || exit 0
